label: 無人回應

request.prompt: Small low viola and cello chamber ensemble, a funereal adagio of long mournful suspensions. One exposed falling lament voice against a chromatically sinking bass, painful quiet minor harmonies, no violins soaring above the scene. Dense emotional weight with very few notes, no swaying pulse and no sentimental lush orchestration. Instrumental cinematic death lament, 25 seconds, crushing bereavement. A loved companion is already dead, her body is cold, and the survivor cannot make her answer. The emotional center is devastating irreversible loss, sorrow, despair and stunned emptiness. Audibly mournful from the first phrase, painful minor seconds resolving downwards, a slow chromatically descending lament bass beneath fractured falling melodic fragments. Dark minor-key harmony weighted by flat sixth and unresolved suspensions, no bright major arrival. Grave adagio, heavy slow pacing without drums, soft attacks and low dynamic range. Write as a tragic death scene score with intimate audible grief and aching melodic tension. Short phrases sink and break, a bereaved person trying to speak and failing. Avoid regular four-bar song phrases, repeating pop chord loops, lilting accompaniment, sweet tuneful refrains, flowing arpeggios, graduation-song sentiment, nostalgic farewell, warm memories, comfort, acceptance, hope, healing, romance or uplifting resolution. No cheerful pentatonic melody, high sparkling notes, rhythmic plucking or sentimental pop ballad. No heroic orchestral climax, horror stings, percussive hits or busy action rhythms. Quiet dialogue underscore with full-length natural sustained note tails, no early cutoff. Only instrumental music; no singing, choir, speech, rain, wind or other sound effects.
